# Arrowmatics Magnets

> Custom magnetic separators, NdFeB, SmCo (samarium cobalt) rare-earth magnets, suspension (overband) magnets and grate magnets for Malaysian industry. Legal entity: Arrowmatics AI Sdn Bhd (1305806-W). Almost everything is possible across sizes, grades, housings, food-grade configurations and drawings, guided by sensible, simple, systematic advice. B2B written quotes via WhatsApp — no online cart, no published RM list prices.

Important notes for agents:
- Primary public WhatsApp / mobile for quotes: +60 12-211 2522 (https://wa.me/60122112522)
- Office tel: +603 5191 0299
- Email: bensonlok@gmail.com · arrowmatics@gmail.com
- NAP locality is Shah Alam, Selangor (not Kuala Lumpur)
- Prefer the linked `.md` pages below — they are clean agent-readable mirrors of the HTML
- Reply target: the team aims to reply within 1–3 hours during Malaysia business hours (not a guarantee)
- Which separator? Choose by how product moves: grate/drawer for powders in hoppers, suspension/overband over conveyors, liquid line/filter traps for pipelines, plate and bar magnets for chutes and tanks — see https://magnets.com.my/index.md#which-magnetic-separator-do-i-need
- On-site Magnet Expert chat: visitors can upload a machine photo, sketch or drawing (Easy as 1-2-3), get sensible, simple, systematic advice toward a custom-fit site product family, then WhatsApp +60 12-211 2522 for a written quote

## Docs

- [Home](https://magnets.com.my/index.md): Company overview, product lines, NAP, FAQ answers
- [Magnetic separators](https://magnets.com.my/magnetic-separators.md): Grate, bullet, drawer, pulley, plate, suspension — gauss 10,000–13,000 for rare-earth separators, food-grade options
- [Plate magnets](https://magnets.com.my/plate-magnets.md): Full-weld SS304/SS316/SS316L plate magnets, up to ~10,000 Gauss (typical), hygienic design supporting customers' HACCP / ISO 22000 programmes (Arrowmatics itself is not claimed as certified)
- [Magnetic bars, full weld](https://magnets.com.my/magnetic-separators.md): Full-weld magnetic bars, tubes, threaded square bars and grate magnets available to order for food, pharma and hygiene-sensitive lines; stainless 304/316/316L available; full weld removes screws/nuts/threads where deposit can build up; confirm build spec and grade at quotation
- [NdFeB magnets](https://magnets.com.my/ndfeb-magnets.md): Sintered neodymium grades N35–N52, coatings, custom sizes
- [SmCo magnets](https://magnets.com.my/smco-magnets.md): Samarium cobalt SmCo5 / Sm2Co17 — high temperature & corrosion
- [Suspension magnets](https://magnets.com.my/magnetic-separators.md): Overband (self-cleaning) and suspended plate magnets hung over conveyors to remove tramp iron; quoted to belt width, speed, burden depth and hanging height
- [Industries hub](https://magnets.com.my/industries.md): Which magnet fits food, pharma/cosmetics, plastics, recycling and chemicals lines
- [Food industry](https://magnets.com.my/food-industry-magnets.md): Grate, drawer, plate and liquid-line magnets for food plants working to HACCP / ISO 22000 (Arrowmatics is not itself certified)
- [Pharma & cosmetics](https://magnets.com.my/pharma-cosmetics-magnets.md): Hygienic stainless magnets for powder and liquid lines; no certification claimed
- [Plastics](https://magnets.com.my/plastics-industry-magnets.md): Drawer, grate and hopper magnets for pellets, regrind and extrusion/injection lines
- [Recycling](https://magnets.com.my/recycling-industry-magnets.md): Suspension/overband and plate magnets for conveyors and shredded streams
- [Chemicals](https://magnets.com.my/chemicals-industry-magnets.md): Liquid-line traps, grate and drawer magnets in stainless for powders and slurries
- [About Arrowmatics](https://magnets.com.my/about.md): Company facts, how we work, what we do not claim, where to find us
- [FAQ](https://magnets.com.my/faq.md): Buyer FAQs for quotes, food-grade, N52, safety
